standards_claimed: Small Form Factor Pluggable (SFP) Transceiver Multi-source Agreement (MSA)
general.notes: Receiver sensitivity is specified as Unstressed Receiver OMA Sensitivity in mW (0.029 mW @ 4.25 Gb/s, 0.042 mW @ 8.5 Gb/s, 0.063 mW @ 14.025 Gb/s at 10^-12 BER), not in dBm. Section VI narrative states operating case temperature -5°C to +85°C while Case Operating Temperature tables list 0°C to 70°C. Electrical Characteristics header gives TOP = -5 to 85 °C for section III; Optical Characteristics and environmental table use TOP 0 to 70 °C. Transmitter output power ranges differ by rate: 14.025 Gb/s -5.0 to +2.0 dBm; 4.25/8.5 Gb/s -5.0 to -1.0 dBm. TDP (Transmitter and Dispersion Penalty) max 4.4 dB @ 14.025 Gb/s and 3.2 dB @ 8.5 Gb/s is not mapped to penalty objects per @-notation rule. Supply current Icc typ 200 mA max 300 mA; module power consumption never exceeds 1 W with established link.
provenance_datasheet_sections: III. Electrical Characteristics (TOP = -5 to 85 °C,  VCC = 3.00 to 3.60 Volts)
IV. Optical Characteristics (TOP = 0 to 70 °C , VCC = 3.15 to 3.45 Volts)
general.suggestions: Consider schema fields for OMA sensitivity (mW/μW) and transmitter dispersion penalty (TDP in dB) common on FC/Ethernet SFP+ datasheets. Clarify whether legal entity should be Coherent Corp. when footer differs from Finisar branding.
